Could you please provide me enough information with reasons in this connection? 2731 views Q. I want to clarify whether doing a job in the Information Technology department at a conventional bank is right or not. Being an IT professional, our duties and responsibilities are only fixing, installing, configuring, and maintaining IT tools like computers, software, ATM machines, and day to day operational engineering activities. As far as financial matters are concerned we have an expense budget to purchase expensive equipments but we do not know the source of these funds; whether they are riba based or profit based. In fact we don't know the source of our salaries either. My senior in bank has told me that he has verbal permission from Darul Uloom Karachi that an IT department job in a bank is permissible. Please clarify if this is permissible or not according to above stated job responsibilities. 4244 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 66211 Country: India Title: Selling skin care products Question: I am planning to start a business of skin care products like body scrub, facial mask, etc that is 100% natural and no chemicals are used in it. Is it permissible for me to start this business? Answer ID: 66211 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 837/837/M=09/1437) If the skin care products are free from haram and impure and harmful ingredients then there is no harm in doing its business. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
